question: Can authorization be granted despite personal deficiency when benefit serves self and others?
premises: The action serves the benefit of self and others.
Authorization may be granted in that case.
No doubt is admitted about this.
inference: One may authorize such use for the benefit of self and others without doubt.
uncertainties: The exact object of authorization is carried over from the previous verse.
plain_english: One may authorize it for the benefit of oneself and others; there is no doubt.
